cell: S02 Rust SDK mixed real-database sequence
boundary: external Cargo consumer to materialized SDK result and reopened close

campaign.order: serial blocks, no rebuild or competing workload
campaign.sample_rule: retain every attempt; reject a block with a failed semantic or reopened-state check; never replace a slow valid sample
campaign.environment_rule: same host, kernel, CPU, storage, governor, toolchain and profiler; no competing jobs; at least 1 GiB free; no measured-child swap; retain and flag host-only paging drift
campaign.statistics: nearest-rank p50/p95 for whole product and named stages, five block medians, min/max, CPU and peak RSS; no p99 or equivalence inference

instrumentation.whole_timer: Instant before Engine::open through reopened Engine::close; fixture construction outside timer; assertions and reads after reopen inside whole timer
instrumentation.independent_oracle: fresh SQLite connection, canonical counts, PRAGMA integrity_check, exact raw/resource/identity hashes
